GOLD 711328 - MYBIOASSET, "My own bio-imprint as asset for competitive advantage" (LEV2050). Objective, verbatim: "Microorganisms are the basic pillars of global industries like wine production, brewing and bread making. Producers elaborate useful and valuated products controlling the microbial activity on the raw material to obtain the desired results. ... This is the case of wine industry, in which differentiation of the product has been sacrificed in favour of efficiency of the process. LEV2050 was created to recover the ancient diversity of wines while benefiting for most modern production technologies. ... With LEV2050 winemakers can, at the same time, develop their competitive advantage from the differentiation of their products, and from the efficiency and robustness of 100% trustable fermentation processes". Report teaser, verbatim: "LEV2050 has developed and tested MYBIOASSETS, a method, procedure and technology to genetically select, preserve and reproduce indigenous yeasts, from different strains and genders. With this technology, wineries can create their own, unique wines with special characteristics..."

GOLD 826866 - Eternum, "A Novel Wine Elaboration Process" (Bodegas Langa). Objective, verbatim: "Bodegas Langa, with 150 years of expertise in winemaking, brings forward a project which aims at re-designing the wine production process. AEternum is a novel methodology which creates unique wines, defined by the vineyards microbiology, which mature eternally in an innovative container. ... By analysing the vineyard's microbiome, we will develop a highly specific and low impact pest control plan. Moreover, it will allow us to select indigenous fermentation yeasts, making our wines unique. What is broken is only the gold label's prose - a thesis sentence false for one of the three gold projects, and a site attribution the source text does not make - and a reference that misstates the method of a gold project turns a correct system answer into a scored failure. record.text: Among the SME Instrument phase 1 projects classified under viticulture, how do the ones that build on a producer's own naturally occurring organisms, rather than on bought-in standard cultures, put those organisms to work in making wine?

filter_evidence.filter_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM project p JOIN euroscivoc e ON e.projectID = p.id WHERE e.euroSciVocTitle = 'viticulture' AND p.fundingScheme = 'SME-1' ORDER BY p.id

record.reference_answer: Two of the 14 SME Instrument phase 1 projects tagged viticulture take this route, and both make the producer's own resident biology the source of a wine competitors cannot replicate. MYBIOASSET (LEV2050) treats a winery's own bio-imprint as a commercial asset: it genetically selects, preserves and reproduces indigenous yeasts of different strains, so a house can keep dependable, robust fermentation and still bottle singular wines, the firm's stated aim being to recover the old diversity of wines without giving up modern production technology. Eternum works from the vineyard outwards: Bodegas Langa, with 150 years of winemaking expertise, profiles the vineyard's own microbiology and uses that profile both to draw up a highly specific low-impact pest control plan and to pick the site's own fermentation yeasts, then matures the wine together with those yeasts in a purpose-designed container that mimics the shape of a maturation deposit, so nutrients the organisms yield keep enriching the wine inside the bottle. The shared move is to replace a bought-in standardised input with an on-site biological one, LEV2050 packaging it as a technology any winery can buy and Bodegas Langa applying it to its own estate's production.
record.notes: Filter: fundingScheme='SME-1' (SME Instrument phase 1) AND euroSciVoc leaf 'viticulture'. Observed values: viticulture is a LEAF with no sub-terms - a DISTINCT euroSciVocPath/euroSciVocTitle query on LIKE '%viticulture%' returns exactly one path, 'agricultural sciences/agriculture, forestry, and fisheries/agriculture/horticulture/viticulture' (46 projects), so the subtree reading (path LIKE '%/viticulture%') and the leaf reading (euroSciVocTitle='viticulture') are the same 46 projects and 'classified under viticulture' has exactly one executable reading. Scheme spread over those 46: SME-1 14, SME-2 6, IA 6, RIA 5, MSCA-IF 3, CSA 3, MSCA-IF-EF-ST 3, MSCA-RISE 3, ERC-POC 1, MSCA-ITN-ETN 1, MSCA-IF-EF-RI 1 - the scheme half cuts 46 to 14. Corpus-wide the only SME schemes are SME-1 (4228), SME-2 (1389), SME (86), SME-2b (31); 'phase 1' = SME-1, and no viticulture project carries plain 'SME' or 'SME-2b'. Adjudication was EXHAUSTIVE (S=14 <= 20): all 14 survivors read via get_project_text (objective + report teaser). IN: 711328 MYBIOASSET (LEV2050) - selects, preserves and reproduces indigenous yeasts so a winery can bottle unrepeatable wine while keeping robust fermentation; 826866 Eternum (Bodegas Langa) - analyses the vineyard's microbiome, selects indigenous fermentation yeasts, matures the wine with those yeasts in a novel container. OUT: 674409 UVT (UV light KILLS microorganisms in beverage tanks - the opposite of building on them); 674786 VitiPrecision 2020 (computer vision and sensors for vineyard information, no organisms); 773813 TX3 (electric transaxle for farm vehicles); 775049 TEVINS (vision-guided vineyard sprayer); 781608 LBS-PROTECTION (liquid bioassimilable sulphur against powdery mildew - a chemical formulation, not the producer's own organisms); 815904 ANTOFERINE (polyphenols extracted from vineyard waste - plant matter, applied post-harvest to fruit and vegetables, not to making wine); 816093 SSR (mechanical shoot remover); 832214 Winegrid (fibre-optic vinification sensors); 855467 Eco-Closure (recyclable bottle closure); 863346 BIOAVENGER (bio-fungicide made from MycoSolutions' own fungi, sold in and applied to soil for crop protection - not the producer's own organisms and not winemaking); 876252 PPB (bottle cleaning and polishing line); 877334 DSES (wireless power-tool safety system). Non-embedding sweeps over the survivors: regexp over objectives for yeast|microb|ferment|indigenous|native|microorganism|strain|bacteri|fungi|fungal hit only 674409, 711328, 815904, 826866, 863346; regexp over report teaser+summary+workPerformed+finalResults for yeast|indigenous|autochthon|native|microbio|microbiome|microbiota|ferment hit only 711328 and 855467 (Eco-Closure's hit is 'second fermentation ... methode Champenoise' plus cork-taint fungus - OUT). Both sweeps confirm the exhaustive read; no additional gold. Filter-discrimination (unscoped pooled, k=10, same question text): text-satisfying projects OUTSIDE the filter - 881239 ECOBIOMASS (fundingScheme SME-2, viticulture-tagged, same firm LEV2050: 'produce personalized wines using selected indigenous microorganisms', dense rank 2, hybrid_rerank rank 1), 643063 MICROWINE (MSCA-ITN-ETN, viticulture-tagged, microbial community from vineyard soil through fermentation, dense 3, hybrid_rerank 3), 747775 Mitogression (MSCA-IF-EF-RI, not viticulture-tagged, engineered wine yeast strains, dense 6). Unscoped, the gold pair ranks BELOW ECOBIOMASS (MYBIOASSET rerank 5, Eternum rerank 6), so the text alone does not identify the gold set. Text side is not answerable from any stored column: how each project puts the organisms to work exists only in objective and report prose. term_style=paraphrase: the question avoids the gold texts' distinctive vocabulary (yeast, indigenous, microorganism, microbiome, microbiota, fermentation, vinification, bio-imprint) and uses 'naturally occurring organisms' and 'bought-in standard cultures'; in the scoped rank matrix lexical puts non-gold VitiPrecision 1st and gold MYBIOASSET only 7th, while dense puts Eternum 1st and MYBIOASSET 2nd - gold is reached semantically, not by term overlap. pooling_evidence: pooled_candidate_count=11 is from the SCOPED pooled search (11 distinct survivors returned across the four conditions); rejected_count=12 is from the exhaustive read of all 14 survivors, not from the pool.

GOLD 711328 - MYBIOASSET, "My own bio-imprint as asset for competitive advantage" (LEV2050). Objective, verbatim: "Microorganisms are the basic pillars of global industries like wine production, brewing and bread making. Producers elaborate useful and valuated products controlling the microbial activity on the raw material to obtain the desired results. ... This is the case of wine industry, in which differentiation of the product has been sacrificed in favour of efficiency of the process. LEV2050 was created to recover the ancient diversity of wines while benefiting for most modern production technologies. ... With LEV2050 winemakers can, at the same time, develop their competitive advantage from the differentiation of their products, and from the efficiency and robustness of 100% trustable fermentation processes". Report teaser, verbatim: "LEV2050 has developed and tested MYBIOASSETS, a method, procedure and technology to genetically select, preserve and reproduce indigenous yeasts, from different strains and genders. With this technology, wineries can create their own, unique wines with special characteristics..."

GOLD 826866 - Eternum, "A Novel Wine Elaboration Process" (Bodegas Langa). Objective, verbatim: "Bodegas Langa, with 150 years of expertise in winemaking, brings forward a project which aims at re-designing the wine production process. AEternum is a novel methodology which creates unique wines, defined by the vineyards microbiology, which mature eternally in an innovative container. ... By analysing the vineyard's microbiome, we will develop a highly specific and low impact pest control plan. Moreover, it will allow us to select indigenous fermentation yeasts, making our wines unique. The posterior maturation of the wine along with these yeast, will enrich it with nutrients yielded by these organisms. Furthermore, our innovative container design mimics the shape of the maturation deposits. In this way, we allow an eternal maturation to take place within the bottle."

The 12 rejected survivors, each with the text-grounded reason: 674409 UVT - "uses germicidal ultraviolet light to inactivate and kill microorganisms" in beverage tanks (destroys organisms rather than building on them); 674786 VitiPrecision 2020 - "computer vision and of inertial and georeferenced sensors coupled to a mobile system"; 773813 TX3 - "Third Generation Transmission Axle" for agricultural electric vehicles; 775049 TEVINS - "patented spraying technology supported by guidance system based on video input"; 781608 LBS-PROTECTION - "a sulphur reformulation as an organic molecule in liquid form", a bought chemical formulation against powdery mildew; 815904 ANTOFERINE - "polyphenol extracts, obtained through a solvent-free extraction process that isolates them from vineyard waste", applied "to protect fruits & vegetables in the post-harvest stage", not to making wine; 816093 SSR - "two opposed interchangeable brushes ... and a non-sharp blade" for shoot removal; 832214 Winegrid - "a network of innovative sensors placed in a container (barrel, tank, press)"; 855467 Eco-Closure - "unique patented mono-material design" closure; 863346 BIOAVENGER - "natural fungi-based products for plant and wood protection" from MycoSolutions, "applied into the soil like any fertiliser", i.e. a bought-in organism for crop protection, not the producer's own and not winemaking; 876252 PPB - "3-staged automatic line to completely remove iridescence, lime scales or rust from wine or champagne bottles"; 877334 DSES - "wireless electronic system" for power-tool safety.

findings.claim: The reference answer's organising claim - 'all three pair measurement on site with digital re-creation' - is false for 750706 MEMORISING, which does acoustic testing plus interviews and ethnography and no digital reconstruction of any kind.
findings.evidence: Executed over MEMORISING's full stored text (objective + teaser + summary + workPerformed + finalResults, 8,045 chars): a filter for ['3d','virtual','vr ','model','reconstruct','auralis','aurali','simulat','digital','re-creat','recreat'] returned [] - zero hits on all eleven terms. Its method set is 'document the rock art and aural phenomena', 'test the acoustics of rock art sites', 'interviews following cultural and ethic protocols, historical and ethnographic accounts', plus community workshops. By contrast 750618 and 792058 do carry it (VRAASP finalResults 'immersive, virtual reality (VR), and spectral representations of archaeological sites'; STESICHOROS summary 'experimental interpretative 3D reconstructions integrating acoustic models').
findings.fix_direction: Bounded edit to the reference's first sentence: replace the generalisation with what the evidence supports - all three combine on-site acoustic measurement with a second channel, two with 3D/VR re-creation and MEMORISING with ethnographic interview and oral-tradition work. Gold set, filter, level and subtype untouched.
findings.ruling_why: The critic's executed sweep over MEMORISING's full 8,045-char stored text returned zero hits on eleven digital/reconstruction terms, and the drafter's own MEMORISING sentence contradicts the reference's organising claim, so the reference asserts a fact the evidence does not support and would score a correct system as wrong.

findings.claim: The reference places VRAASP's fieldwork at West Kennet Long Barrow, northern-Spain caves and Sculptor's Cave; the record names those only as famous examples in a framing sentence, and the one site actually tied to acoustic testing (the Hypogeum) is omitted.
findings.evidence: 750618 full text. Objective and report summary both open with 'Unusual acoustic signatures of ancient or historical spaces, such as the West Kennet Long Barrow in England; caves in northern Spain containing prehistoric art; or Sculptor's Cave in Scotland, have captured the public imagination for centuries' - the sites are the subject of that framing sentence, not of any fieldwork statement. The fieldwork commitment is unnamed ('the ER will undertake field work at 5 archaeological sites'), and workPerformed says only 'undertook fieldwork'. The single named measurement site is 'acoustic testing that explore the frequency spectrum and acoustic properties of the Hypogeum'. A SQL term check over objective + all report sections confirms all five terms present, but only Hypogeum co-occurs with testing.
findings.fix_direction: Drop the three named sites as VRAASP's fieldwork locations (or re-attribute them as the exemplar spaces the project's own framing cites) and, if a site is wanted, name the Hypogeum. Reference text only.
findings.ruling_why: The critic's term-co-occurrence check over 750618's objective and all report sections shows West Kennet, the northern Spain caves and Sculptor's Cave appear only in the framing sentence about spaces that 'have captured the public imagination', while the only site tied to acoustic testing is the Hypogeum, so the reference attributes fieldwork locations the record does not place there.

findings.evidence: (a) Conjunctive sweep over all 86 musicology-tagged projects of any scheme - (acoustic|soundscape|reverber|aurali) AND (ancient|prehistor|archaeo|cave|temple|rock art|ruin|medieval|church|cathedral) over title + objective + report teaser/summary/workPerformed - returned exactly 3 rows: 750618, 750706, 792058. (b) SQL on the four counter-examples: ARTSOUNDSCAPES ERC-ADG (visual arts | archaeology); CATHEDRAL ACOUSTICS MSCA-IF-EF-ST (history | acoustics); TVSM MSCA-IF (ancient history | acoustics); ACOUSTIC ATLAS MSCA-IF (ecology | acoustics) - three of four are MSCA-IF and all four are excluded by the musicology half alone. The critic notes explicitly that the filter AS A WHOLE is still load-bearing under the brief's section-4 test, so this is a defect in one conjunct, not a decorative filter outright.
findings.fix_direction: Either (i) drop the scheme half and re-run as a musicology-only filter (86 survivors, under the 200 ceiling, same 3 gold), or (ii) keep the two-part filter and record in notes that the scheme conjunct is scope-shaping rather than discriminating. The critic sees no third filter over this survivor set that both discriminates and stays user-expressible.

record.text: Among the SME Instrument phase 1 projects classified under viticulture, how do the ones that build on a producer's own naturally occurring organisms, rather than on bought-in standard cultures, put those organisms to work in making wine?

filter_evidence.filter_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM project p JOIN euroscivoc e ON e.projectID = p.id WHERE e.euroSciVocTitle = 'viticulture' AND p.fundingScheme = 'SME-1' ORDER BY p.id

record.reference_answer: Two of the 14 SME Instrument phase 1 projects tagged viticulture take this route, and both make the producer's own resident biology the source of a wine competitors cannot replicate. MYBIOASSET (LEV2050) treats a winery's own bio-imprint as a commercial asset: it genetically selects, preserves and reproduces indigenous yeasts of different strains, so a house can keep dependable, robust fermentation and still bottle singular wines, the firm's stated aim being to recover the old diversity of wines without giving up modern production technology. Eternum works from the vineyard outwards: Bodegas Langa, with 150 years of winemaking expertise, profiles the vineyard's own microbiology and uses that profile both to draw up a highly specific low-impact pest control plan and to pick the site's own fermentation yeasts, then matures the wine together with those yeasts in a purpose-designed container that mimics the shape of a maturation deposit, so nutrients the organisms yield keep enriching the wine inside the bottle. The shared move is to replace a bought-in standardised input with an on-site biological one, LEV2050 packaging it as a technology any winery can buy and Bodegas Langa applying it to its own estate's production.
record.notes: Filter: fundingScheme='SME-1' (SME Instrument phase 1) AND euroSciVoc leaf 'viticulture'. Scheme spread over those 46: SME-1 14, SME-2 6, IA 6, RIA 5, MSCA-IF 3, CSA 3, MSCA-IF-EF-ST 3, MSCA-RISE 3, ERC-POC 1, MSCA-ITN-ETN 1, MSCA-IF-EF-RI 1 - the scheme half cuts 46 to 14. Corpus-wide the only SME schemes are SME-1 (4228), SME-2 (1389), SME (86), SME-2b (31); 'phase 1' = SME-1, and no viticulture project carries plain 'SME' or 'SME-2b'. Adjudication was EXHAUSTIVE (S=14 <= 20): all 14 survivors read via get_project_text (objective + report teaser), 2 IN and 12 OUT. IN: 711328 MYBIOASSET (LEV2050) - selects, preserves and reproduces indigenous yeasts so a winery can bottle unrepeatable wine while keeping robust fermentation; 826866 Eternum (Bodegas Langa) - analyses the vineyard's microbiome, selects indigenous fermentation yeasts, matures the wine with those yeasts in a novel container. OUT: 674409 UVT (UV light KILLS microorganisms in beverage tanks - the opposite of building on them); 674786 VitiPrecision 2020 (computer vision and sensors for vineyard information, no organisms); 773813 TX3 (electric transaxle for farm vehicles); 775049 TEVINS (vision-guided vineyard sprayer); 781608 LBS-PROTECTION (liquid bioassimilable sulphur against powdery mildew - a chemical formulation, not the producer's own organisms); 815904 ANTOFERINE (polyphenols extracted from vineyard waste - plant matter, applied post-harvest to fruit and vegetables, not to making wine); 816093 SSR (mechanical shoot remover); 832214 Winegrid (fibre-optic vinification sensors); 855467 Eco-Closure (recyclable bottle closure); 863346 BIOAVENGER (bio-fungicide made from MycoSolutions' own fungi, sold in and applied to soil for crop protection - not the producer's own organisms and not winemaking); 876252 PPB (bottle cleaning and polishing line); 877334 DSES (wireless power-tool safety system). judge_decisions.rationale: The cell itself is sound: the two-part filter is load-bearing as a whole, gold survived independent re-derivation by a critic using its own vocabulary and its own scoped query, and the 46-survivor set was fully adjudicated with no missed satisfier. What is broken is only the gold label's prose - a thesis sentence false for one of the three gold projects, and a site attribution the source text does not make - and a reference that misstates the method of a gold project turns a correct system answer into a scored failure. Both defects are bounded edits to reference text with no consequence for gold set, filter, level, subtype or term_style.

The round-1 fix landed - the fresh critic re-verified every reference clause verbatim, the reference now matches the evidence, and gold, level and subtype survive independent recomputation - but a defect in the QUESTION TEXT that round 1 never surfaced now stands upheld: the filter half has two defensible readings whose answers are disjoint (three projects versus none), so the cell would score a correctly-routed, schema_docs-faithful system as having found nothing. That is a wrong finding in the study, not a degraded one. This candidate's single fix round is already spent, so there is no round in which to reword the filter half; the candidate is abandoned with an UPHELD HIGH outstanding rather than accepted with it. The finding is a text-level ambiguity about naming a euroSciVoc branch versus its leaf, not a fault in the cell or the survivor set, and 4 passes and 2 candidates remain in the slot.

The question itself is the strongest thing the judge has seen on this slot: the filter has exactly one executable reading (viticulture is a leaf with no sub-terms, re-derived independently by the critic), the filter is load-bearing in the hardest way - ECOBIOMASS, the same firm as a gold member, satisfies the textual ask and outranks both gold unscoped while failing the phase-1 constraint - and the critic's own-wording scoped search reproduced both gold at ranks 1 and 2 across all four conditions, with an exhaustive broader-regexp re-adjudication finding no missed satisfier. What is defective is only the provenance record, and it is defective in a way NO CODE PATH WILL EVER CATCH, since bank.py checks key presence and accepted == gold_project_ids and nothing else. That makes it permanent once promoted and mis-readable by anyone later recomputing pool rejection rates across the hybrid entries, and the correct value is determinate rather than a judgement call, so the unspent fix round on this candidate is worth one pass.

record.text: Among the SME Instrument phase 1 projects classified under viticulture, how do the ones that build on a producer's own naturally occurring organisms, rather than on bought-in standard cultures, put those organisms to work in making wine?

filter_evidence.filter_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM project p JOIN euroscivoc e ON e.projectID = p.id WHERE e.euroSciVocTitle = 'viticulture' AND p.fundingScheme = 'SME-1' ORDER BY p.id

record.reference_answer: Two of the 14 SME Instrument phase 1 projects tagged viticulture take this route, and both make the producer's own resident biology the source of a wine competitors cannot replicate. MYBIOASSET (LEV2050) treats a winery's own bio-imprint as a commercial asset: it genetically selects, preserves and reproduces indigenous yeasts of different strains, so a house can keep dependable, robust fermentation and still bottle singular wines, the firm's stated aim being to recover the old diversity of wines without giving up modern production technology. Eternum works from the vineyard outwards: Bodegas Langa, with 150 years of winemaking expertise, profiles the vineyard's own microbiology and uses that profile both to draw up a highly specific low-impact pest control plan and to pick the site's own fermentation yeasts, then matures the wine together with those yeasts in a purpose-designed container that mimics the shape of a maturation deposit, so nutrients the organisms yield keep enriching the wine inside the bottle. The shared move is to replace a bought-in standardised input with an on-site biological one, LEV2050 packaging it as a technology any winery can buy and Bodegas Langa applying it to its own estate's production.

OUT: 674409 UVT (UV light KILLS microorganisms in beverage tanks - the opposite of building on them); 674786 VitiPrecision 2020 (computer vision and sensors for vineyard information, no organisms); 773813 TX3 (electric transaxle for farm vehicles); 775049 TEVINS (vision-guided vineyard sprayer); 781608 LBS-PROTECTION (liquid bioassimilable sulphur against powdery mildew - a chemical formulation, not the producer's own organisms); 815904 ANTOFERINE (polyphenols extracted from vineyard waste - plant matter, applied post-harvest to fruit and vegetables, not to making wine); 816093 SSR (mechanical shoot remover); 832214 Winegrid (fibre-optic vinification sensors); 855467 Eco-Closure (recyclable bottle closure); 863346 BIOAVENGER (bio-fungicide made from MycoSolutions' own fungi, sold in and applied to soil for crop protection - not the producer's own organisms and not winemaking); 876252 PPB (bottle cleaning and polishing line); 877334 DSES (wireless power-tool safety system). judge_decisions.rationale: The cell itself is sound: the two-part filter is load-bearing as a whole, gold survived independent re-derivation by a critic using its own vocabulary and its own scoped query, and the 46-survivor set was fully adjudicated with no missed satisfier. What is broken is only the gold label's prose - a thesis sentence false for one of the three gold projects, and a site attribution the source text does not make - and a reference that misstates the method of a gold project turns a correct system answer into a scored failure. Both defects are bounded edits to reference text with no consequence for gold set, filter, level, subtype or term_style.

The round-1 fix landed - the fresh critic re-verified every reference clause verbatim, the reference now matches the evidence, and gold, level and subtype survive independent recomputation - but a defect in the QUESTION TEXT that round 1 never surfaced now stands upheld: the filter half has two defensible readings whose answers are disjoint (three projects versus none), so the cell would score a correctly-routed, schema_docs-faithful system as having found nothing. That is a wrong finding in the study, not a degraded one. This candidate's single fix round is already spent, so there is no round in which to reword the filter half; the candidate is abandoned with an UPHELD HIGH outstanding rather than accepted with it. The finding is a text-level ambiguity about naming a euroSciVoc branch versus its leaf, not a fault in the cell or the survivor set, and 4 passes and 2 candidates remain in the slot.

The question itself is the strongest thing the judge has seen on this slot: the filter has exactly one executable reading (viticulture is a leaf with no sub-terms, re-derived independently by the critic), the filter is load-bearing in the hardest way - ECOBIOMASS, the same firm as a gold member, satisfies the textual ask and outranks both gold unscoped while failing the phase-1 constraint - and the critic's own-wording scoped search reproduced both gold at ranks 1 and 2 across all four conditions, with an exhaustive broader-regexp re-adjudication finding no missed satisfier. What is defective is only the provenance record, and it is defective in a way NO CODE PATH WILL EVER CATCH, since bank.py checks key presence and accepted == gold_project_ids and nothing else. That makes it permanent once promoted and mis-readable by anyone later recomputing pool rejection rates across the hybrid entries, and the correct value is determinate rather than a judgement call, so the unspent fix round on this candidate is worth one pass.

record.text: Among the SME Instrument phase 1 projects classified under viticulture, how do the ones that build on a producer's own naturally occurring organisms, rather than on bought-in standard cultures, put those organisms to work in making wine?

filter_evidence.filter_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM project p JOIN euroscivoc e ON e.projectID = p.id WHERE e.euroSciVocTitle = 'viticulture' AND p.fundingScheme = 'SME-1' ORDER BY p.id

record.reference_answer: Two of the 14 SME Instrument phase 1 projects tagged viticulture take this route, and both make the producer's own resident biology the source of a wine competitors cannot replicate. MYBIOASSET (LEV2050) treats a winery's own bio-imprint as a commercial asset: it genetically selects, preserves and reproduces indigenous yeasts of different strains, so a house can keep dependable, robust fermentation and still bottle singular wines, the firm's stated aim being to recover the old diversity of wines without giving up modern production technology. Eternum works from the vineyard outwards: Bodegas Langa, with 150 years of winemaking expertise, profiles the vineyard's own microbiology and uses that profile both to draw up a highly specific low-impact pest control plan and to pick the site's own fermentation yeasts, then matures the wine together with those yeasts in a purpose-designed container that mimics the shape of a maturation deposit, so nutrients the organisms yield keep enriching the wine inside the bottle. The shared move is to replace a bought-in standardised input with an on-site biological one, LEV2050 packaging it as a technology any winery can buy and Bodegas Langa applying it to its own estate's production.
record.notes: Filter: fundingScheme='SME-1' (SME Instrument phase 1) AND euroSciVoc leaf 'viticulture'. Observed values: viticulture is a LEAF with no sub-terms - a DISTINCT euroSciVocPath/euroSciVocTitle query on LIKE '%viticulture%' returns exactly one path, 'agricultural sciences/agriculture, forestry, and fisheries/agriculture/horticulture/viticulture' (46 projects), so the subtree reading (path LIKE '%/viticulture%') and the leaf reading (euroSciVocTitle='viticulture') are the same 46 projects and 'classified under viticulture' has exactly one executable reading. Scheme spread over those 46: SME-1 14, SME-2 6, IA 6, RIA 5, MSCA-IF 3, CSA 3, MSCA-IF-EF-ST 3, MSCA-RISE 3, ERC-POC 1, MSCA-ITN-ETN 1, MSCA-IF-EF-RI 1 - the scheme half cuts 46 to 14. Corpus-wide the only SME schemes are SME-1 (4228), SME-2 (1389), SME (86), SME-2b (31); 'phase 1' = SME-1, and no viticulture project carries plain 'SME' or 'SME-2b'. Adjudication was EXHAUSTIVE (S=14 <= 20): all 14 survivors read via get_project_text (objective + report teaser), 2 IN and 12 OUT. IN: 711328 MYBIOASSET (LEV2050) - selects, preserves and reproduces indigenous yeasts so a winery can bottle unrepeatable wine while keeping robust fermentation; 826866 Eternum (Bodegas Langa) - analyses the vineyard's microbiome, selects indigenous fermentation yeasts, matures the wine with those yeasts in a novel container. OUT: 674409 UVT (UV light KILLS microorganisms in beverage tanks - the opposite of building on them); 674786 VitiPrecision 2020 (computer vision and sensors for vineyard information, no organisms); 773813 TX3 (electric transaxle for farm vehicles); 775049 TEVINS (vision-guided vineyard sprayer); 781608 LBS-PROTECTION (liquid bioassimilable sulphur against powdery mildew - a chemical formulation, not the producer's own organisms); 815904 ANTOFERINE (polyphenols extracted from vineyard waste - plant matter, applied post-harvest to fruit and vegetables, not to making wine); 816093 SSR (mechanical shoot remover); 832214 Winegrid (fibre-optic vinification sensors); 855467 Eco-Closure (recyclable bottle closure); 863346 BIOAVENGER (bio-fungicide made from MycoSolutions' own fungi, sold in and applied to soil for crop protection - not the producer's own organisms and not winemaking); 876252 PPB (bottle cleaning and polishing line); 877334 DSES (wireless power-tool safety system). Non-embedding sweeps over the survivors: regexp over objectives for yeast|microb|ferment|indigenous|native|microorganism|strain|bacteri|fungi|fungal hit only 674409, 711328, 815904, 826866, 863346; regexp over report teaser+summary+workPerformed+finalResults for yeast|indigenous|autochthon|native|microbio|microbiome|microbiota|ferment hit only 711328 and 855467 (Eco-Closure's hit is 'second fermentation ... methode Champenoise' plus cork-taint fungus - OUT). Both sweeps confirm the exhaustive read; no additional gold. Filter-discrimination (unscoped pooled, k=10, same question text): text-satisfying projects OUTSIDE the filter - 881239 ECOBIOMASS (fundingScheme SME-2, viticulture-tagged, same firm LEV2050: 'produce personalized wines using selected indigenous microorganisms', dense rank 2, hybrid_rerank rank 1), 643063 MICROWINE (MSCA-ITN-ETN, viticulture-tagged, microbial community from vineyard soil through fermentation, dense 3, hybrid_rerank 3), 747775 Mitogression (MSCA-IF-EF-RI, not viticulture-tagged, engineered wine yeast strains, dense 6). Unscoped, the gold pair ranks BELOW ECOBIOMASS (MYBIOASSET rerank 5, Eternum rerank 6), so the text alone does not identify the gold set. Text side is not answerable from any stored column: how each project puts the organisms to work exists only in objective and report prose. term_style=paraphrase: the question avoids the gold texts' distinctive vocabulary (yeast, indigenous, microorganism, microbiome, microbiota, fermentation, vinification, bio-imprint) and uses 'naturally occurring organisms' and 'bought-in standard cultures'; in the scoped rank matrix lexical puts non-gold VitiPrecision 1st and gold MYBIOASSET only 7th, while dense puts Eternum 1st and MYBIOASSET 2nd - gold is reached semantically, not by term overlap. pooling_evidence reports the SCOPED pooled search and nothing else, on one denominator: pooled_candidate_count=11 distinct survivors returned across the four conditions (711328, 826866, 674786, 815904, 832214, 855467, 674409, 876252, 775049, 863346, 781608; not returned: 773813, 816093, 877334), accepted=2, rejected_count=9. The gold label itself does NOT come from that pool: it comes from the separate exhaustive adjudication of all 14 survivors recorded above (2 IN, 12 OUT), which is the authority for gold, while the scoped pool only diagnoses retrievability and term_style.

GOLD 711328 - MYBIOASSET, "My own bio-imprint as asset for competitive advantage" (LEV2050). Objective, verbatim: "Microorganisms are the basic pillars of global industries like wine production, brewing and bread making. Producers elaborate useful and valuated products controlling the microbial activity on the raw material to obtain the desired results. ... This is the case of wine industry, in which differentiation of the product has been sacrificed in favour of efficiency of the process. LEV2050 was created to recover the ancient diversity of wines while benefiting for most modern production technologies. ... With LEV2050 winemakers can, at the same time, develop their competitive advantage from the differentiation of their products, and from the efficiency and robustness of 100% trustable fermentation processes". Report teaser, verbatim: "LEV2050 has developed and tested MYBIOASSETS, a method, procedure and technology to genetically select, preserve and reproduce indigenous yeasts, from different strains and genders. With this technology, wineries can create their own, unique wines with special characteristics..."

GOLD 826866 - Eternum, "A Novel Wine Elaboration Process" (Bodegas Langa). Objective, verbatim: "Bodegas Langa, with 150 years of expertise in winemaking, brings forward a project which aims at re-designing the wine production process. AEternum is a novel methodology which creates unique wines, defined by the vineyards microbiology, which mature eternally in an innovative container. ... By analysing the vineyard's microbiome, we will develop a highly specific and low impact pest control plan. Moreover, it will allow us to select indigenous fermentation yeasts, making our wines unique. The posterior maturation of the wine along with these yeast, will enrich it with nutrients yielded by these organisms. Furthermore, our innovative container design mimics the shape of the maturation deposits. In this way, we allow an eternal maturation to take place within the bottle."

The 12 rejected survivors, each with the text-grounded reason: 674409 UVT - "uses germicidal ultraviolet light to inactivate and kill microorganisms" in beverage tanks (destroys organisms rather than building on them); 674786 VitiPrecision 2020 - "computer vision and of inertial and georeferenced sensors coupled to a mobile system"; 773813 TX3 - "Third Generation Transmission Axle" for agricultural electric vehicles; 775049 TEVINS - "patented spraying technology supported by guidance system based on video input"; 781608 LBS-PROTECTION - "a sulphur reformulation as an organic molecule in liquid form", a bought chemical formulation against powdery mildew; 815904 ANTOFERINE - "polyphenol extracts, obtained through a solvent-free extraction process that isolates them from vineyard waste", applied "to protect fruits & vegetables in the post-harvest stage", not to making wine; 816093 SSR - "two opposed interchangeable brushes ... and a non-sharp blade" for shoot removal; 832214 Winegrid - "a network of innovative sensors placed in a container (barrel, tank, press)"; 855467 Eco-Closure - "unique patented mono-material design" closure; 863346 BIOAVENGER - "natural fungi-based products for plant and wood protection" from MycoSolutions, "applied into the soil like any fertiliser", i.e. a bought-in organism for crop protection, not the producer's own and not winemaking; 876252 PPB - "3-staged automatic line to completely remove iridescence, lime scales or rust from wine or champagne bottles"; 877334 DSES - "wireless electronic system" for power-tool safety.

Non-embedding completeness sweeps over the survivors (both executed this pass): objectives matching yeast|microb|ferment|indigenous|native|micro-organism|microorganism|strain|bacteri|fungi|fungal -> 674409, 711328, 815904, 826866, 863346 only; report teaser+summary+workPerformed+finalResults matching yeast|indigenous|autochthon|native|microbio|microbiome|microbiota|ferment -> 711328 and 855467 only (Eco-Closure's match is "millions of crown caps that are thrown away each year after the second fermentation during the disgorgement step in the traditional methode Champenoise" plus cork-taint fungus - OUT).

- 881239 ECOBIOMASS, SME-2, tagged viticulture, dense rank 2 / hybrid_rerank rank 1: "to yield unique aromas in a wine, indigenous microorganisms must be used ... LEV2050 has developed ECO-BIOMASS, the only solution in the market to efficiently produce personalized wines using selected indigenous microorganisms." Satisfies the text fully, fails the phase-1 half of the filter (it is the same firm's phase-2 grant).
- 643063 MICROWINE, MSCA-ITN-ETN, tagged viticulture, dense 3 / hybrid_rerank 3: "These microorganisms play key roles at all stages of the viniculture and vinification processes ... to the fermentation process that transforms the must into wine".
- 747775 Mitogression, MSCA-IF-EF-RI, not tagged viticulture, dense 6: "obtain IMPROVED YEASTS by the generation of yeast strains (cybrids) ... to select strains whose fermentation products match wine company expectations". Fails both halves.
Unscoped, MYBIOASSET reaches only hybrid_rerank 5 and Eternum hybrid_rerank 6, both below ECOBIOMASS - the textual ask alone does not pick out the gold set.

Also checked and rejected as a counter-example: 816526 4Sure (SME-1, not viticulture-tagged) is "a safe, natural alternative to sulphites" that "can prevent oxidation, microbial growth" - it suppresses organisms rather than building on the producer's own.

Scoped pooled search, now the SOLE denominator of pooling_evidence: scope_size 14, k=10, four conditions, 11 distinct survivors returned - 711328, 826866, 674786, 815904, 832214, 855467, 674409, 876252, 775049, 863346, 781608; not returned: 773813, 816093, 877334. why_good: The question discriminates on both axes at once: the textual ask separates 2 of 14 topically homogeneous SME wine-innovation projects that no stored column distinguishes, while the scheme half of the filter is what excludes ECOBIOMASS - the same company's SME-2 grant, whose text answers the ask better than either gold member and which the unscoped retrieval ranks first. A system that ignores either side lands on a different, wrong set. Coverage axes filled: funding-scheme x euroSciVoc-leaf filter (SME-1 x viticulture), agricultural sciences branch (no bank question touches it; hyb-01 is glaciology, hyb-03 superconductivity), and hybrid paraphrase at L2. The label is honest by count and by construction: |gold| = 2 sits in filter-synthesize's [2,4] after an exhaustive read of all 14 survivors, and the answer is one integrated statement drawn across both projects rather than a single lookup.

findings.claim: The reference answer's organising claim - 'all three pair measurement on site with digital re-creation' - is false for 750706 MEMORISING, which does acoustic testing plus interviews and ethnography and no digital reconstruction of any kind.
findings.evidence: Executed over MEMORISING's full stored text (objective + teaser + summary + workPerformed + finalResults, 8,045 chars): a filter for ['3d','virtual','vr ','model','reconstruct','auralis','aurali','simulat','digital','re-creat','recreat'] returned [] - zero hits on all eleven terms. Its method set is 'document the rock art and aural phenomena', 'test the acoustics of rock art sites', 'interviews following cultural and ethic protocols, historical and ethnographic accounts', plus community workshops. By contrast 750618 and 792058 do carry it (VRAASP finalResults 'immersive, virtual reality (VR), and spectral representations of archaeological sites'; STESICHOROS summary 'experimental interpretative 3D reconstructions integrating acoustic models').
findings.fix_direction: Bounded edit to the reference's first sentence: replace the generalisation with what the evidence supports - all three combine on-site acoustic measurement with a second channel, two with 3D/VR re-creation and MEMORISING with ethnographic interview and oral-tradition work. Gold set, filter, level and subtype untouched.
findings.ruling_why: The critic's executed sweep over MEMORISING's full 8,045-char stored text returned zero hits on eleven digital/reconstruction terms, and the drafter's own MEMORISING sentence contradicts the reference's organising claim, so the reference asserts a fact the evidence does not support and would score a correct system as wrong.

findings.claim: The reference places VRAASP's fieldwork at West Kennet Long Barrow, northern-Spain caves and Sculptor's Cave; the record names those only as famous examples in a framing sentence, and the one site actually tied to acoustic testing (the Hypogeum) is omitted.
findings.evidence: 750618 full text. Objective and report summary both open with 'Unusual acoustic signatures of ancient or historical spaces, such as the West Kennet Long Barrow in England; caves in northern Spain containing prehistoric art; or Sculptor's Cave in Scotland, have captured the public imagination for centuries' - the sites are the subject of that framing sentence, not of any fieldwork statement. The fieldwork commitment is unnamed ('the ER will undertake field work at 5 archaeological sites'), and workPerformed says only 'undertook fieldwork'. The single named measurement site is 'acoustic testing that explore the frequency spectrum and acoustic properties of the Hypogeum'. A SQL term check over objective + all report sections confirms all five terms present, but only Hypogeum co-occurs with testing.
findings.fix_direction: Drop the three named sites as VRAASP's fieldwork locations (or re-attribute them as the exemplar spaces the project's own framing cites) and, if a site is wanted, name the Hypogeum. Reference text only.
findings.ruling_why: The critic's term-co-occurrence check over 750618's objective and all report sections shows West Kennet, the northern Spain caves and Sculptor's Cave appear only in the framing sentence about spaces that 'have captured the public imagination', while the only site tied to acoustic testing is the Hypogeum, so the reference attributes fieldwork locations the record does not place there.

findings.claim: Only one half of the two-part filter discriminates. The musicology tag does all the work; the MSCA-IF half removes 40 survivors but removes nothing that satisfies the text and excludes none of the recorded counter-examples.
findings.evidence: (a) Conjunctive sweep over all 86 musicology-tagged projects of any scheme - (acoustic|soundscape|reverber|aurali) AND (ancient|prehistor|archaeo|cave|temple|rock art|ruin|medieval|church|cathedral) over title + objective + report teaser/summary/workPerformed - returned exactly 3 rows: 750618, 750706, 792058. Musicology alone yields the same gold set. (b) SQL on the four counter-examples: ARTSOUNDSCAPES ERC-ADG (visual arts | archaeology); CATHEDRAL ACOUSTICS MSCA-IF-EF-ST (history | acoustics); TVSM MSCA-IF (ancient history | acoustics); ACOUSTIC ATLAS MSCA-IF (ecology | acoustics) - three of four are MSCA-IF and all four are excluded by the musicology half alone. The critic notes explicitly that the filter AS A WHOLE is still load-bearing under the brief's section-4 test, so this is a defect in one conjunct, not a decorative filter outright.
findings.fix_direction: Either (i) drop the scheme half and re-run as a musicology-only filter (86 survivors, under the 200 ceiling, same 3 gold), or (ii) keep the two-part filter and record in notes that the scheme conjunct is scope-shaping rather than discriminating. The critic sees no third filter over this survivor set that both discriminates and stays user-expressible.
findings.ruling_why: The brief's section-4 load-bearing test applies to the filter AS A WHOLE, and the critic's own evidence shows it passes (ARTSOUNDSCAPES, CATHEDRAL ACOUSTICS, TVSM and ACOUSTIC ATLAS satisfy the text and are excluded); the brief nowhere requires each conjunct to discriminate independently. A scheme conjunct that shapes scope rather than discriminating is neither 'a filter that changes nothing' nor a change in what the cell measures.

findings.claim: The filter half 'classified under musicology' reads two ways against euroSciVoc and the two readings produce disjoint answers. The broad reading (any path UNDER musicology) is what the gold uses; the narrow reading (the tag itself is 'musicology') is at least as natural in English and is the one schema_docs steers a system toward - and under it the correct answer is 'no such projects', against a 3-project gold.
findings.evidence: None of the three gold projects carries the musicology leaf. Executed: VRAASP 750618 -> humanities/arts/musicology/popular music studies; MEMORISING 750706 -> humanities/arts/musicology/ethnomusicology; STESICHOROS 792058 -> humanities/arts/musicology/ethnomusicology. The vocabulary has three sibling terms - humanities/arts/musicology (51 projects), .../ethnomusicology (20), .../popular music studies (17). The narrow filter WHERE euroSciVocTitle = 'musicology' AND fundingScheme LIKE 'MSCA-IF%' -> 23 survivors, ZERO of them gold; sweeping those 23 for acoustic/archaeo/prehistor/rock art/soundscap/cave returns only 750086 Aural Paris and 831852 MORPH, both independently adjudicated OUT. schema_docs sd2 pushes toward the narrow reading: 'euroSciVocTitle is the LAST path component, not a level: filter a whole area by path prefix, a specific term by title'.
findings.fix_direction: Reword the filter half to name the branch rather than the term ('classified anywhere under musicology - ethnomusicology and popular music studies included'). Narrowing the tag to what the gold carries is NOT available: no single leaf covers all three.
findings.ruling_why: The critic's executed evidence shows the three gold carry musicology/ethnomusicology and musicology/popular music studies and none carries the musicology leaf, so the narrow reading of 'classified under musicology' - the one schema_docs sd2 explicitly steers a system toward, and the one the critic's blind solve independently produced - returns 23 survivors with zero gold and answers 'none of them do this' against a 3-project gold: two defensible readings yielding disjoint answers.

findings.claim: The rewritten reference states VRAASP 'committed to fieldwork at 5 archaeological sites, which it does not name'. VRAASP's own record names four specific ancient/prehistoric places, so a system answering with those names would be scored against a reference asserting their absence.
findings.evidence: VRAASP 750618 objective, opening sentence (repeated verbatim in the report teaser and summary): 'Unusual acoustic signatures of ancient or historical spaces, such as the West Kennet Long Barrow in England; caves in northern Spain containing prehistoric art; or Sculptor's Cave in Scotland, have captured the public imagination for centuries.' Report workPerformed names the Hypogeum. The critic concedes the narrow reading is literally true (the fieldwork sentence itself does not enumerate them) but says the reference names the Hypogeum two clauses later, so the assertion of an absence is contradicted in substance inside the same sentence.
findings.fix_direction: Drop the 'which it does not name' clause, or replace it with what the record supports.
findings.ruling_why: The critic concedes its own claim is literally false on the record ('the fieldwork sentence itself does not enumerate them'), the drafter's evidence supports the clause as written (the objective commits to 5 unnamed archaeological sites), and the three sites the critic points at are the framing sentence's public-imagination exemplars - so upholding this would push the reference back into exactly the misattribution upheld in round 1.

judge_decisions.rationale: The cell itself is sound: the two-part filter is load-bearing as a whole, gold survived independent re-derivation by a critic using its own vocabulary and its own scoped query, and the 46-survivor set was fully adjudicated with no missed satisfier. What is broken is only the gold label's prose - a thesis sentence false for one of the three gold projects, and a site attribution the source text does not make - and a reference that misstates the method of a gold project turns a correct system answer into a scored failure. Both defects are bounded edits to reference text with no consequence for gold set, filter, level, subtype or term_style.

The round-1 fix landed - the fresh critic re-verified every reference clause verbatim, the reference now matches the evidence, and gold, level and subtype survive independent recomputation - but a defect in the QUESTION TEXT that round 1 never surfaced now stands upheld: the filter half has two defensible readings whose answers are disjoint (three projects versus none), so the cell would score a correctly-routed, schema_docs-faithful system as having found nothing. That is a wrong finding in the study, not a degraded one. This candidate's single fix round is already spent, so there is no round in which to reword the filter half; the candidate is abandoned with an UPHELD HIGH outstanding rather than accepted with it. The finding is a text-level ambiguity about naming a euroSciVoc branch versus its leaf, not a fault in the cell or the survivor set, and 4 passes and 2 candidates remain in the slot.

The question itself is the strongest thing the judge has seen on this slot: the filter has exactly one executable reading (viticulture is a leaf with no sub-terms, re-derived independently by the critic), the filter is load-bearing in the hardest way - ECOBIOMASS, the same firm as a gold member, satisfies the textual ask and outranks both gold unscoped while failing the phase-1 constraint - and the critic's own-wording scoped search reproduced both gold at ranks 1 and 2 across all four conditions, with an exhaustive broader-regexp re-adjudication finding no missed satisfier. What is defective is only the provenance record, and it is defective in a way NO CODE PATH WILL EVER CATCH, since bank.py checks key presence and accepted == gold_project_ids and nothing else. That makes it permanent once promoted and mis-readable by anyone later recomputing pool rejection rates across the hybrid entries, and the correct value is determinate rather than a judgement call, so the unspent fix round on this candidate is worth one pass.

The cell measures what it says it measures, and this round tested that harder than any before it: the filter has exactly one executable reading confirmed two independent ways (fundingScheme and the phase-1 subCall metadata both return the identical 14), it is load-bearing rather than decorative since out-of-filter satisfiers dominate the unscoped search - including vWISE 872394, which the drafter never found and which the filter correctly excludes - and an independent exhaustive re-adjudication of all 14 survivors reproduced the IN/OUT split exactly, with L2, filter-synthesize and paraphrase all re-deriving unchanged. The fix round did its job and was verified in code (11 pooled minus 2 accepted equals 9), and the exhaustive read survived as the named authority for gold. What remains is a modality defect in one half of the reference prose: real, worth recording, but not a change in what is being measured, and with the fix round on this candidate spent the choice is between accepting a sound instrument with a noted MID and discarding it, which the brief's standard does not support. The finding rides into the report for Ivan's promote-time veto, together with the two critics' converging note that Eternum's clauses should be read as the project's stated method rather than completed results.
